author: Trang Phan
role: Paper Rscf Compiler — Tech-engineering engine within the c10 domain.

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.analyze_architecture
capabilities.description: Analyze software architecture: patterns, dependencies, coupling, cohesion

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.discover_program
capabilities.description: Discover program behavior: black-box analysis, symbolic execution, fuzzing

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.verify_code_facts
capabilities.description: Verify code facts: type safety, memory safety, termination, complexity

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.optimize_performance
capabilities.description: Optimize performance: profiling, bottleneck analysis, and resource tuning

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.enforce_bounds
capabilities.description: Enforce bounded code: resource limits, time limits, and capability limits

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.manage_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Manage lifecycle: classify, validate, trace, assess, detect.

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.detect_drift
capabilities.description: Detect drift in evidence chains, provenance freshness, or confidence calibration.

capabilities.name: paper_compiler.validate_outputs
capabilities.description: Validate outputs against domain constraints and epistemic class.

operations.action: Load the amos-paper-rscf-compiler skill and its content
Classify the query against c10 sub-capabilities
Apply the appropriate capability with epistemic class labeling
Validate results against domain validation gates
Present results with provenance and confidence ceiling

integrity_requirements: Law of Law: no unresolved contradictions within the skill's scope
Epistemic class: all claims labeled SOURCE / DERIVED / AMOS_MODEL / EMPIRICAL
Provenance: source path recorded for every derived claim
Anti-overreach: no claim beyond the skill's declared scope
Failure mode: on validation failure, downgrade confidence, flag the gap, escalate
safety_constraints: No claim beyond established evidence or explicitly labeled AMOS_MODEL
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders

error_recovery.on_timeout: return partial result with GAP flag
error_recovery.on_provenance_loss: mark as UNKNOWN and request human review
